bibl.title: Didymus the Blind’s Commentary on Psalms 26:10–29:2 and 36:1–3 (P.BYU 1)
bibl.seg: Lincoln H. Blumell, with Thomas W. Mackay, Gregg Schwendner & Michael R. Trotter, Didymus the Blind's Commentary on Psalms 26:10-29:2 and 36:1-3. The Brigham Young University Papyri. I (P. BYU I).
Turnhout, Brepols, 2019, xvi-210 pp., figg. ISBN 978-2-503-58370-9. €90.
bibl.note: P. BYU I. - Edition of 22 further pages of P. Tura (= van Haelst 644; LDAB 776): five folia comprising quinion eight (Pss. 26:10-29:2) and the first bifolium of quire sixteen (Ps. 36:1-3) of Didymus' Psalm commentary. - Introduction. - Articulated Greek text. - English translation. - Diplomatic transcription. - Notes. - Appendix I: Psalms Catenae preserving Didymus; - Appendix II: Column and margin heights and widths.
